decisions_of_record: container law: syllabai-ink/1 VERBATIM, never bumped — the server contract (packages/contracts/src/pdf-drawings.ts inkDocSchema) validates the container only (shapes: z.array(z.unknown()), elements opaque), so new kinds ride the existing wire with zero contract/api/db bytes; the honest-parse boundary IS the forward/backward compat law; a version bump would make old clients parseDoc→null the whole doc (forbidden)

mtext kind: { id, kind:'mtext', page, color, sizeFrac, x, y, tex } — KaTeX source 1..1000 chars; renders via katex.renderToString(throwOnError:false, displayMode:false) in a pointer-events:none DOM overlay per [data-page] (the InstrumentGuides family), normalized 0..1 positioning, sizeFrac × page-width sizing, currentColor; malformed tex renders error-styled honestly; editing = inline textarea (LaTeX), commit blur/Ctrl+Enter, Esc cancels

NOT MathLive: MG's math box is a MathLive <math-field> (virtual-keyboard policy manual, observed live) — declined on the MG-INK-SDK-GATE bundle/licence discipline (the tldraw verdict stands); katex ^0.16.23 is already a hub dependency

tombstone kind: { id: <targetId>, kind:'tombstone', page } — deletion reuses the target's id so the existing rebaseShapes union-by-id (local-wins on collision) makes erasure survive every 409 rebase and migration upload with zero merge-law changes; old clients drop the unknown kind and their full-doc PUT persists the deletion (pass-through-safe); undo restores the pre-erase snapshot verbatim; Clear all stays set-replacement (the disclosed cross-writer asymmetry of the revision law stands)

eraser: dedicated tool, whole-shape atomic (no pixel erase — shapes are atomic in the grammar), hit-disc tolerance css-px max(12, current pen width px) dpr-independent, ONE commit per gesture (one undo step), no eraser-size UI

select/move (the operator's 'optionally' DECIDED IN): explicit Select tool; tap hit-test (strokes: point-to-segment distance ≤ css-px tolerance; text/mtext: bbox + 4 css px) → dashed bbox affordance (DOM overlay); drag translates (css-px intent converted per-axis at commit — the aspect law); Delete/Backspace or ✕ tombstones; Esc/tap-empty deselects; SINGLE-shape only, no rotate/resize/multi-select (guides keep their own grips)

painter hardening: paintShapes kind-switch with explicit skip for tombstone/mtext/ANY unknown kind (the current `else paintText` would throw s.text.split on undefined for an unknown kind — a latent hazard against forward evolution); strokes+text painting byte-identical; the T-MG-CROPMARK-1 crop composite keeps strokes+text verbatim

crop disclosure: mtext does NOT composite into the region-crop marking bitmap this run (the DOM overlay is not canvas pixels) — rasterization (font-inlined foreignObject) is a NAMED future card candidate on the operator's word, never silently assumed; marking is login-gated anyway, the anonymous posture is untouched

posture invariants re-pinned verbatim: mock-mode exclusion, MS-pane exclusion, region-mark token+paperId gate (anonymous marking stays impossible, local ink never feeds the ledger), past-papers-QP-only; sync gate preserved (sync module never constructed without a token); new kinds flow through BOTH stores via the shared packDoc/parseDoc boundary; the local store's zero-contact law untouched
